server.description: The physical reference of the two-module lunar habitat: the Lab and Hab-B as two volumes of air in mass (the substrate's atmosphere, ideal gas), four persons by name at their own activity wired into the crew of their module, the centralised CO2 scrubber in the Lab in its datasheet's units (a flow, an efficiency, a lag) drawing the Lab's air at the measured command, the inter-module ventilation as a fan on its curve through a filter whose fouling sets what it delivers, the loop exchanging the two airs at that flow, the hatch closed, and the two CO2 sensors at the station's resolution. Built from specs/habitat-parameters.json, every constant with its source.
server.instructions: Start from this graph, do not rebuild it: instantiate it and adapt its numbers. What the documentation gives is known and held at its default (the scrubber's Qe, eta and lag from its datasheet; the resting rate). What only the installation knows is fitted: the Lab's volume V, Hab-B's volume Vh, and the filter's loading L, which is what the ventilation delivers (0 is a clean filter at the design flow). The operators' rate g is a band: fit it within it. Set who is on board with labOccupants and habOccupants (the roster's persons first, unnamed beyond them). Judge it on the two sensors against the logger's columns.

instantiate.title: Instantiate the habitat reference
instantiate.description: The habitat reference as a twin of this station: the variables below as formulas in its nodes, the settings shaping who is on board, the scrubber's command from the telemetry's speed column, the two volumes seeded from the first reading of their sensor.

properties.V: the Lab's volume, m3: the volume the scrubber serves, what the commissioning measures; fitted (the design drawing says 32, the racks take some)
properties.Vh: Hab-B's volume, m3: the living quarters and the rest of the pressurised volume, not documented as built; fitted
properties.L: the filter's loading, kg of dust: what the inter-module ventilation delivers, through the fan's curve against the filter's resistance; 0 is a clean filter at the design flow (3 m3/min), 0.127 about two thirds of it; fitted
properties.g: the CO2 an operator at light work produces, L/min: NASA's band for a crewmember awake, 0.26 to 0.45, reference 0.38; placed within the band
properties.gRest: the CO2 a person at rest produces, L/min: between asleep and awake, 0.30 for the reference crewmember; known
properties.Qe: the scrubber's effective flow at full command, m3/min: its air flow times its single-pass efficiency; the registered scrubber's own number (effectiveFlowAtFull) when the task carries the register, the datasheet's 1.0 otherwise; held, never fitted
properties.eta: the scrubber's single-pass removal efficiency; the registered scrubber's own number (singlePassEfficiency) when the task carries the register, the datasheet's 0.30 otherwise; held
properties.lag: the time constant of the scrubber's response to a change of command, minutes; the registered scrubber's own number (lagTimeConstant) when the task carries the register, the datasheet's 3.33 otherwise; held
properties.labOccupants: how many people are in the Lab: the roster's operators first (FE-1, FE-2 at light work), unnamed people at light work beyond them
properties.habOccupants: how many people are in Hab-B: the roster's first (CDR, FE-3 at rest), unnamed people at rest beyond them
